header: Enable permissions on your AWS account
content:
Your AWS account must have permission to access CloudFormation and Lambda, along with
whichever AWS service you choose for your template – either SageMaker Runtime or Amazon
Bedrock.
If you're using Amazon Bedrock, you must also register your model. See Model access in the
Amazon Bedrock User Guide to register your model.
If you're using your own Amazon S3 bucket to provide model artifacts, you must add the
CloudFormation IAM role to your S3 access policy. For more information, see Adding and removing
IAM identity permissions in the IAM User Guide.
